freePlan.limits: Up to 5 hosts, 1-day metric retention (Infrastructure Free)

keyLimits.en: Priced per host per month; 15-month data retention; 100 custom metrics and 500 custom events per host
Priced per host per month; machine learning alerts, live processes, governance console; 200 custom metrics and 1,000 custom events per host

addOns.en: APM (Application Performance Monitoring): from $36/host/month standalone (annual), or from $31/host/month bundled with Infrastructure
Log Management: ingest $0.10/GB, standard indexing $1.70 per million events/month (annual), flex storage $0.05 per million events/month
Feature Flags: $55/month per 1M monthly flag configuration requests (annual)
AI Credits (Bits Chat, Investigation, Code, Agent Builder): $500 for 500 credits/month (annual) or $1.30/credit on-demand

cautions.en: Pricing is primarily per-host and per-usage across many separately billed modules (infra, APM, logs, feature flags, AI credits); the total cost scales with the number of hosts and volume of telemetry, not a flat per-seat fee.
On-demand (month-to-month) pricing is notably higher than annual commitment pricing across all modules (e.g. Infrastructure Pro is $15/host/month annual vs $18/host/month on-demand).

capabilities.en: Infrastructure, application (APM), network, and log monitoring in one integrated platform.
Real User Monitoring (RUM) and synthetic testing for frontend/user-facing performance.
Security features including cloud security posture management, code security (SAST/SCA/IaC scanning), and Cloud SIEM.
Developer tooling: CI/CD visibility, test optimization, feature flags, code coverage, and an internal developer portal.
AI-assisted troubleshooting and chat features (Bits Investigation, Bits Chat) for incident response.

limitations.en: Cost structure is complex and modular: infrastructure, APM, logs, feature flags, code coverage, and AI credits are billed separately, making total spend hard to predict without usage history.
The free Infrastructure plan is capped at 5 hosts and only 1-day metric retention, unsuitable for production use beyond small test environments.
Full capability (APM, logs, security) requires stacking multiple paid modules on top of Infrastructure Pro/Enterprise, not a single flat plan.

reason.en: Focused alternative for error tracking and application monitoring, lighter weight than Datadog's full observability suite.
Open-source metrics monitoring alternative with no per-host licensing cost, requiring self-hosting and more setup.
Open-source/self-hostable observability and dashboarding platform, a common lower-cost substitute for Datadog dashboards and alerting.
Simpler, more affordably priced uptime, logs, and incident monitoring platform aimed at smaller teams.
Alternative or complement focused specifically on incident management and on-call alerting rather than full observability.

missingAlternatives.name: New Relic
missingAlternatives.reason: Major direct competitor in full-stack observability (APM, infrastructure, logs) not in the catalogue.

missingAlternatives.name: Dynatrace
missingAlternatives.reason: Enterprise-grade observability platform competing directly with Datadog, not in the catalogue.

unknowns: No explicit trial length stated on the pricing page for most Datadog products.
Whether taxes are included in listed prices is not stated on the pricing page.
Exact scope of what counts as a 'host' for billing purposes (e.g. containers, serverless functions) is not detailed on the pricing page itself and requires deeper docs review.
